name: Olive & Ivory
blurb: Soft and elegant: cream, charcoal and olive green. The name writes itself in handwriting, then a photo contact sheet lets you mark favourites Keep or Pass.
shows: Photo gallery that feels like a photographer's proof sheet, a big-photo viewer, an enquiry form.

name: Bright Circuit Electrical
blurb: Bold navy and safety yellow, like a technical drawing. A line runs down the page like an electrical circuit, and an Emergency call button is always on screen.
shows: Service switches you can flip, a step-by-step enquiry, an urgent call button that is always in reach.

name: Salt & Ember
blurb: Dark, warm and dramatic. Real fire footage, and the name lights up letter by letter. The menu photo changes as you pick a course.
shows: Menu with photos, a table booking request, film in the opening.

name: Sunny Hours Club
blurb: Bright, playful shapes and colours. Parents can build a weekly timetable by dragging or tapping activities onto days.
shows: An interactive weekly planner, clear practical information for parents, an enquiry form.

name: Clear Ground Coaching
blurb: Calm and spacious, like a magazine. One hand-drawn line follows you down the page, and a few gentle questions lead to an enquiry.
shows: A guided enquiry that feels like a conversation, a scrolling story, a calm film window.

name: Little Kettle Café
blurb: Warm and friendly, with coffee being poured in a window-shaped film. A specials board of tiles that flip over, and a menu you tap to build an order.
shows: A flip-tile specials board, a tabbed menu, a table order, a booking request.

name: The Corner Shelf
blurb: Like a catalogue: big type and drawn products sitting on shelves you can filter and turn over. A basket shows how shopping could work.
shows: Filter by category, look closely at a product, a basket (demonstration only, no payment).

name: Oak & Razor
blurb: Dark, confident and bold, with huge lettering that moves with the film. Services open up as you tap, then a step-by-step appointment request.
shows: An expanding services list, an appointment picker (example times only), film behind the name.
